archetypes.name: dyn-reachability
archetypes.rationale: Agent-lint exclusions and moved registries must preserve reachability coverage without reloading inventory prose.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on the agent-lint exclude block and deleted /design and /implement inventories. Verify every removed reachability-only path is either covered by the temporary exclude block or intentionally preserved in lazy reader documentation. Check that the new extracted-script registry remains reader-facing and does not recreate deleted machine-reachability inventories in always-loaded skill prose. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
